notes: New interface: rebuilt from the ground up with a floating workspace, a home screen with build status and activity, and a single settings panel.
Attach is now reachable from the editor toolbar, the home screen and settings, and live Roblox output streams into the console.
Settings now cover the executor, AI & MCP, Script Hub (Rscripts key) and update checks in one place.
New app icon and Riptide branding throughout.
Requires Roblox 0.745.0.7451137. If you are on a different build, re-run the install script — it pins the right one.
